dataset.limits: Local visible synthetic practice, not hidden judging or proof of real-world financial performance. Inputs only go to adapters; answers stay with the evaluator.

market_summary.verdict: Beat buy-and-hold more often than chance would explain on these paths.

limits: Passing defined checks does not validate an entire product. Market completion is not profitability. Synthetic data is not a real-world benchmark. This runner is not an OS security sandbox.
